settings.adaptive_preheat_enabled.descri: Use learned heating rate to compute pre-heat start time.
settings.adaptive_preheat_enabled.label: Adaptive Pre-heat Timing
settings.adaptive_setback_enabled.descri: Use learned heating/cooling rate to compute maximum safe setback depth.
settings.adaptive_setback_enabled.label: Adaptive Bedtime Setback
settings.aggressive_savings.description: When enabled, favors energy savings: the economizer skips AC-assisted cooling (ventilation only when windows open), and setbacks may be more aggressive. When disabled, AC actively cools to comfort when outdoor temps drop.
settings.aggressive_savings.label: Prefer savings over comfort
settings.ai.line: {requests, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}} · {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}} · {cost} this month · circuit breaker {breaker}
settings.ai.line_model: Model {model} · {requests, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}} · {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}} · {cost} this month · circuit breaker {breaker}
settings.ai.title: AI
settings.ai_api_key.description: Built-in Claude only. Your Anthropic API key. Stored securely in Home Assistant's config entry. Never logged or exposed in sensor attributes.
settings.ai_api_key.label: Claude API Key
settings.ai_auto_requests_per_day.descri: Maximum automated/scheduled AI requests per day. Limits unattended usage from features like daily plan generation. Resets at midnight.
settings.ai_auto_requests_per_day.label: Auto Requests Per Day
settings.ai_enabled.description: Master switch for all AI-powered features. When disabled, Climate Advisor uses only its built-in coded logic.
settings.ai_enabled.label: Enable AI Features
settings.ai_investigator_enabled.descrip: Enable the investigative agent, which performs deep cross-source analysis to find incongruities, data quality issues, and system errors. Requires AI to be enabled and configured. Default is off.
settings.ai_investigator_enabled.label: Enable Investigative Agent
settings.ai_investigator_requests_per_da: Maximum investigative analysis runs per day. Each investigation uses extended thinking and is more expensive than other AI requests. Resets at midnight.
settings.ai_manual_requests_per_day.desc: Maximum user-triggered AI requests per day. Limits on-demand usage from features like the Investigative Analysis report. Resets at midnight.
settings.ai_max_tokens.description: Maximum length of AI responses in tokens. Higher values allow more detailed analysis but cost more.
settings.ai_max_tokens.label: Maximum Response Length
settings.ai_model.description: Built-in Claude only. Which Claude model to use. Sonnet is recommended for cost/quality balance. Haiku is cheapest. Opus is most capable but expensive.
settings.ai_model.label: AI Model
settings.ai_monthly_budget.description: Maximum estimated monthly spend in USD. Set to 0 for no limit. AI features pause when budget is reached.
settings.ai_monthly_budget.label: Monthly Budget Cap
settings.ai_provider.description: Which AI writes the investigation. Home Assistant AI Task uses an AI integration you already set up in Home Assistant (for example OpenAI, Google, Anthropic or Ollama). Built-in Claude is deprecated and will be removed. Applies to all zones.
settings.ai_provider.label: AI Provider
settings.ai_reasoning_effort.description: Built-in Claude only. How much reasoning effort Claude uses. Higher effort produces better analysis but uses more tokens and costs more.
settings.ai_reasoning_effort.label: Reasoning Effort
settings.ai_task_entity.description: The Home Assistant AI Task entity that writes the investigation. Leave empty to use Home Assistant's preferred AI Task entity (Settings > System > AI). It needs a context window of at least 16k tokens and an output limit of at least 8192 tokens. Applies to all zones.
settings.ai_task_entity.label: AI Task Entity
settings.ai_temperature.description: Controls randomness in AI responses. 0 = deterministic, 1.0 = most creative. 0.3 recommended for analysis.
settings.ai_temperature.label: Creativity
settings.automation_grace_notify.descrip: Send a push notification when the automation grace period expires.
settings.automation_grace_notify.label: Push: Automation Grace Expired
settings.automation_grace_seconds.descri: After Climate Advisor resumes HVAC (all doors/windows closed), this grace window prevents immediate re-pausing if a door opens briefly.
settings.automation_grace_seconds.label: Automated Change Cooldown
On a multi-zone install, only one zone should send the scheduled daily briefing push/email — otherwise you get one copy per zone. Turn this ON for exactly one zone. Using Send briefing under Actions on the dashboard always sends, even when this is off.
settings.briefing_time.description: When the daily climate briefing is generated and sent. Should be before wake_time so you see it when you get up.
settings.briefing_time.label: Daily Briefing Time
settings.climate_entity.description: The climate entity Climate Advisor controls. All HVAC mode and temperature commands go to this entity.
settings.climate_entity.label: Thermostat
settings.comfort_cool.description: Target temperature when cooling is active. Raising saves energy but may feel warmer. The economizer uses this as the threshold for window cooling decisions.
settings.comfort_cool.label: Comfortable Cooling Temperature
settings.comfort_deadband_cold_f.descrip: On a cold day: how many degrees past a comfort edge the house may go, right after the opposite mode ran (within the Recent Run Window), before the opposite mode is switched on. On a cold day this applies to switching to cooling (the heating side is never delayed). Going further than this switches at once. This is a tolerance, not the distance at which an edge is pre-armed (that is fixed at 2 degrees, or a third of your comfort range if smaller).
settings.comfort_deadband_cold_f.label: Cold Day Overshoot Tolerance
settings.comfort_deadband_cool_f.descrip: On a cool day: how many degrees past a comfort edge the house may go, right after the opposite mode ran (within the Recent Run Window), before the opposite mode is switched on. On a cool day this applies to switching to cooling (the heating side is never delayed). Going further than this switches at once. This is a tolerance, not the distance at which an edge is pre-armed (that is fixed at 2 degrees, or a third of your comfort range if smaller).
settings.comfort_deadband_cool_f.label: Cool Day Overshoot Tolerance
settings.comfort_deadband_hot_f.descript: On a hot day: how many degrees past a comfort edge the house may go, right after the opposite mode ran (within the Recent Run Window), before the opposite mode is switched on. On a hot day this applies to switching to heating (the cooling side is never delayed). Going further than this switches at once. This is a tolerance, not the distance at which an edge is pre-armed (that is fixed at 2 degrees, or a third of your comfort range if smaller).
settings.comfort_deadband_hot_f.label: Hot Day Overshoot Tolerance
settings.comfort_deadband_mild_f.descrip: On a mild or off-classified day: how many degrees past a comfort edge the house may go, right after the opposite mode ran (within the Recent Run Window), before the opposite mode is switched on. Mild days have no favored side, so this applies to both heat and cool. Going further than this switches at once. This is a tolerance, not the distance at which an edge is pre-armed (that is fixed at 2 degrees, or a third of your comfort range if smaller).
settings.comfort_deadband_mild_f.label: Mild Day Overshoot Tolerance
settings.comfort_deadband_warm_f.descrip: On a warm day: how many degrees past a comfort edge the house may go, right after the opposite mode ran (within the Recent Run Window), before the opposite mode is switched on. On a warm day this applies to switching to heating (the cooling side is never delayed). Going further than this switches at once. This is a tolerance, not the distance at which an edge is pre-armed (that is fixed at 2 degrees, or a third of your comfort range if smaller).
settings.comfort_deadband_warm_f.label: Warm Day Overshoot Tolerance
settings.comfort_family_recency_window_m: How long the heat or cool side counts as having "recently run" (equipment that actually ran, or a time-of-use, predicted-ceiling or you-initiated mode change; not every Climate Advisor write). Used by the overshoot tolerance above (a small overshoot inside this window does not flip the thermostat to the opposite mode) and by the predicted-temperature ceiling guard (which waits instead of acting on a predicted overshoot).
settings.comfort_heat.description: Target temperature when heating is active. Lowering saves energy but may feel cooler. Used for morning wake-up and occupancy-home restores.
settings.comfort_heat.label: Comfortable Heating Temperature
settings.comfort_mode_switch_min_interva: Minimum wait between routine heat/cool switches, to prevent rapid back-and-forth. A real breach (indoor temp actually past a comfort edge) ignores this wait and switches immediately.
settings.cool_lockout_outdoor_temp.descr: Climate Advisor does not cool while the outdoor temperature is below this (Issue #1699). It allows cooling again once it is two Celsius degrees warmer. If the house gets hotter than the ceiling by more than the day's overshoot tolerance, cooling runs anyway. Leave empty for no lockout.
settings.cool_lockout_outdoor_temp.label: No cooling below outdoor
settings.cool_power_kw.description: Average electrical power your cooling draws while it runs (in kW; check the nameplate or a smart plug). Optional: used with the energy rate to estimate daily cost. Left blank, no cost is shown.
settings.cool_power_kw.label: Cooling Power
settings.count: {shown, number} of {total, plural, one {# setting} other {# settings}} · read-only here
settings.count_changed: {shown, number} of {total, plural, one {# setting} other {# settings}} · read-only here · {changed, number} changed from default
settings.default_preheat_minutes.descrip: Pre-heat duration used before enough observations are collected.
settings.default_preheat_minutes.label: Default Pre-heat Time
settings.default_tou_lead_minutes.descri: How long before a scheduled high-cost period the system starts pre-conditioning, used until enough heat/cool cycles are observed to compute your home's actual rate.
settings.default_tou_lead_minutes.label: TOU Pre-conditioning Lead Time
settings.door_window_sensors.description: Binary sensors that detect open doors and windows. When open past the debounce period, HVAC pauses to avoid wasting energy.
settings.door_window_sensors.label: Door/Window Sensors
settings.email_briefing.description: Send the full daily briefing via email with complete forecast and plan details.
settings.email_briefing.label: Email: Daily Briefing
settings.email_door_window_pause.descrip: Send an email when HVAC is paused due to an open door or window.
settings.email_door_window_pause.label: Email: HVAC Paused
settings.email_entity_health.description: Send an email when a configured entity (thermostat, weather source, sensor, fan, toggle, or notification service) is removed or stops responding.
settings.email_entity_health.label: Email: Entity Not Found
settings.email_grace_expired.description: Send an email when a grace period expires and normal sensor behavior resumes.
settings.email_grace_expired.label: Email: Grace Expired
settings.email_grace_repause.description: Email when HVAC is re-paused because a door/window is still open after grace.
settings.email_grace_repause.label: Email: HVAC Re-paused
settings.email_occupancy_home.descriptio: Send an email when someone arrives home and comfort temperature is restored.
settings.email_occupancy_home.label: Email: Welcome Home
settings.energy_rate.description: What a kilowatt-hour costs you, in your own currency. Optional: with the heating and cooling power below it lets the Analysis tab estimate each day's cost. Left blank, no cost is shown.
settings.energy_rate.label: Energy Rate
settings.fan_entity.description: The fan or switch entity to control for whole-house ventilation. Only used when fan mode is 'whole_house_fan' or 'both'.
settings.fan_entity.label: Fan Entity
settings.fan_min_runtime_per_hour.descri: Minutes of fan runtime per hour (0 = disabled, 60 = always on). Activates the fan for the specified duration each hour for air circulation. The cycle start time is offset from the clock hour based on when HA started.
settings.fan_min_runtime_per_hour.label: Fan Minimum Runtime Per Hour
settings.fan_mode.description: Controls how fans assist ventilation. 'Whole house fan' controls a dedicated entity. 'HVAC fan' uses the thermostat fan mode. Fan activates during economizer maintain phase.
settings.fan_mode.label: Fan Control Mode
settings.fan_remote_entity.description: Optional event entity (e.g. from the gunkl/quietcool-house-fan ESPHome firmware) that fires when the physical RF wall remote is pressed. When set, a remote timer selection (1/2/4/8/12 hours) sets the duration of the fan manual-override grace period, so CA honors the user's chosen runtime instead of the configured default. Leave blank to disable — no subscription is created and behavior is unchanged.
settings.fan_remote_entity.label: Fan RF Remote Event Entity
settings.fan_state_entity.description: Optional separate sensor entity to read the actual physical state of the whole-house fan. Use when the fan has a dedicated control entity and a separate state sensor (WHF dual-entity). If left blank, the Fan Entity is used for both control and state.
settings.fan_state_entity.label: Fan State Entity
settings.fan_state_feedback.description: Turn ON if your fan entity or state sensor reports actual motor state (not just the last command sent). Leave OFF if you're not sure — CA will command the fan to the desired state on every cycle without reading back the entity state. Physical wall-switch overrides are undetectable when OFF.
settings.fan_state_feedback.label: Fan State Feedback Reliable
settings.foot.basic: These are the current settings, read-only. Changed-from-default markers, time-of-use schedules and GitHub status appear once Climate Advisor is updated to serve them.
settings.foot.full: These are the current settings. They are read-only here; use Change in Home Assistant to edit them.
settings.github.add_token: Add a token and repository in Home Assistant (Configure, GitHub integration) so Analysis can file issues.
settings.github.configured: Repository {repo}, access token {token, select, set {set} other {missing}}. Analysis can file reports as issues.
settings.github.repo_no_token: Repository {repo} is set but no access token is set.
settings.github.title: GitHub issues

settings.guest_toggle_entity.description: An entity that indicates guests are present. Overrides vacation and away modes — the house stays at comfort temperature while guests are visiting.
settings.guest_toggle_entity.label: Guest Mode Toggle
settings.guest_toggle_invert.description: Enable if your toggle reports ON when guests are NOT present.
settings.guest_toggle_invert.label: Invert Guest Toggle
settings.heat_lockout_outdoor_temp.descr: Climate Advisor does not heat while the outdoor temperature is above this (Issue #1699). It allows heating again once it is two Celsius degrees colder. If the house gets colder than the floor by more than the day's overshoot tolerance, heating runs anyway. Must be at least two Celsius degrees above the cooling lockout. Leave empty for no lockout.
settings.heat_lockout_outdoor_temp.label: No heating above outdoor
settings.heat_power_kw.description: Average electrical power your heating draws while it runs (in kW; check the nameplate or a smart plug). Optional: used with the energy rate to estimate daily cost. Left blank, no cost is shown.
settings.heat_power_kw.label: Heating Power
settings.home_toggle_entity.description: An entity that indicates whether someone is home. ON = home, OFF = away. Climate Advisor applies setback temperatures when away.
settings.home_toggle_entity.label: Home/Away Toggle
settings.home_toggle_invert.description: Enable if your toggle reports ON when you're away and OFF when you're home.
settings.home_toggle_invert.label: Invert Home Toggle
settings.humid_air_guard_ceiling_f.descr: Outdoor dew point at or above which the Humid-Air Guard never starts the fan or suggests opening the windows, whatever the house's humidity. Lower blocks more nights. The guard releases just below it.
settings.humid_air_guard_ceiling_f.label: Humid-Air Dew Point Ceiling
settings.humid_air_guard_enabled.descrip: When on, the whole-house fan and natural ventilation do not start, and opening the windows is not suggested, while the outdoor air is too humid: its dew point is at or above the ceiling, or the outdoor air is humid and clearly wetter than the house. The house stays closed and the AC holds your temperatures. A running session is not stopped. Without an outdoor humidity reading nothing changes. On by default.
settings.humid_air_guard_enabled.label: Humid-Air Guard
settings.hvac_fan_restrict_mode.descript: Restricts when the HVAC fan (thermostat blower circulation) is allowed to run, based on which HVAC mode last ran. Does not affect the whole-house fan. 'Heat only' blocks the HVAC fan while the thermostat is in cool mode, or off within 2 hours of a cooling cycle — avoids raising humidity by re-evaporating condensate off wet coils, useful in humid climates. 'Cool only' is the symmetric restriction. 'Both' (default) applies no restriction — current behavior.
settings.hvac_fan_restrict_mode.label: HVAC Fan Restriction
settings.hvac_season.description: Auto lets Climate Advisor heat and cool. Heat only or Cool only removes the other side for the season, as if the thermostat could not do it (Issue #1699). A house far past the removed side's comfort edge still gets it.
settings.hvac_season.label: Heating and cooling season
settings.indoor_humidity_entity.descript: The humidity sensor in the room Climate Advisor reads by day, shown on the Status chart with how warm the room feels. Chart only: no heating or cooling decision uses it. Leave blank to detect automatically.
settings.indoor_humidity_entity.label: Indoor Humidity Sensor
settings.indoor_temp_source.description: Where indoor temperature is read from: the thermostat's built-in sensor, a dedicated sensor, or an input_number helper.
settings.indoor_temp_source.label: Indoor Temperature Source
settings.integrations.unavailable: Integration status is not available right now.
settings.learning_enabled.description: When enabled, Climate Advisor tracks patterns (manual overrides, window compliance, runtime) and generates adaptive suggestions over time.
settings.learning_enabled.label: Enable Learning & Suggestions
settings.manual_grace_notify.description: Push notification when manual grace expires and normal behavior resumes.
settings.manual_grace_notify.label: Push: Manual Grace Expired
settings.manual_grace_seconds.descriptio: After you manually change the thermostat — either the HVAC mode or the target temperature — CA waits this many minutes before resuming automated setpoint control. Also prevents re-pausing if a door/window opens during this window. Default: 30 minutes.
settings.manual_grace_seconds.label: Manual Change Pause
settings.max_preheat_minutes.description: Longest pre-heat window the system will ever schedule.
settings.max_preheat_minutes.label: Maximum Pre-heat Time
settings.max_setback_depth_f.description: Largest overnight setback the adaptive engine may compute.
settings.max_setback_depth_f.label: Maximum Setback Depth
settings.min_preheat_minutes.description: Shortest pre-heat window the system will ever schedule.
settings.min_preheat_minutes.label: Minimum Pre-heat Time
settings.nat_vent_soft_start_enabled.des: When enabled, the whole-house fan may start at outdoor/indoor temperature parity (not waiting for outdoor to be measurably cooler) once today's outdoor temperature is confirmed past its peak and declining — for air movement and attic/thermal-mass purge, not bulk cooling. On by default; disable if you only want the fan to run once outdoor is measurably cooler than indoor. No humidity/dew-point sensor guards this today.
settings.notify_service.description: The HA notify service used for alerts and briefings (e.g., notify.mobile_app).
settings.notify_service.label: Notification Service
settings.outdoor_humidity_entity.descrip: The outdoor humidity sensor shown on the Status chart with how warm or cold it feels outside. Chart only: no heating or cooling decision uses it. Leave blank to detect automatically.
settings.outdoor_humidity_entity.label: Outdoor Humidity Sensor
settings.outdoor_temp_source.description: Where outdoor temperature is read from: the weather service, a dedicated sensor, or an input_number helper. The Settings value also names the selected sensor, and says so when it has failed and the weather service is in use instead.
settings.outdoor_temp_source.label: Outdoor Temperature Source
settings.override_confirm_seconds.descri: Time between system changes and confirmation of manual override. When a change looks like a manual override, Climate Advisor waits this long before formally accepting it. Transient events (thermostat restart, fan cycle) that resolve within the window are ignored. Set to 0 to confirm overrides immediately.
settings.override_confirm_seconds.label: Override Confirmation Delay
settings.preheat_safety_margin.descripti: Multiplier applied to model-computed pre-heat time as a buffer (e.g. 1.2 = 20% extra).
settings.preheat_safety_margin.label: Pre-heat Safety Margin
settings.primary_engine.description: Which prediction engine Climate Advisor uses: v4 (default, a per-sensor model learned from your house) or v3 (the established model). It times pre-heat and pre-cool, the ceiling guard, the window-close time and setback depth, and it is the main line on the Status chart and the Next 24 hours plan. While it is still learning, those decisions use their default behaviour (never the other engine) and the chart shows the schedule estimate.
settings.primary_engine.label: Prediction engine
settings.push_briefing.description: Send a short TLDR briefing summary to your phone each morning.
settings.push_briefing.label: Push: Daily Briefing
settings.push_door_window_pause.descript: Send a push notification when HVAC is paused due to an open door or window.
settings.push_door_window_pause.label: Push: HVAC Paused
settings.push_entity_health.description: Send a push notification when a configured entity (thermostat, weather source, sensor, fan, toggle, or notification service) is removed or stops responding.
settings.push_entity_health.label: Push: Entity Not Found
settings.push_occupancy_home.description: Send a push notification when someone arrives home and comfort temperature is restored.
settings.push_occupancy_home.label: Push: Welcome Home
settings.sensor_debounce_seconds.descrip: How long a door/window sensor's state must hold steady before Climate Advisor acts on it — pausing/resuming HVAC, or engaging/exiting natural-ventilation fan control (whole-house fan or HVAC fan). Applies to every controlled device, not just HVAC. Short values react faster but are more exposed to quick trips through a door or a flaky sensor bounce; longer values are steadier but slower to respond to a genuine change.
settings.sensor_debounce_seconds.label: Sensor Debounce Delay
settings.sensor_polarity_inverted.descri: Enable if your sensors report 'off' when open (some reed switches work this way). Incorrect polarity means HVAC pauses when doors are closed.
settings.sensor_polarity_inverted.label: Invert Sensor Polarity
settings.setback_cool.description: Temperature when cooling and away from home. Higher values save more energy but take longer to cool down when you return.
settings.setback_cool.label: Away Cooling Temperature
settings.setback_heat.description: Temperature when heating and away from home. Lower values save more energy but take longer to recover when you return.
settings.setback_heat.label: Away Heating Temperature
settings.shadow_engine.description: An optional second engine drawn as a comparison line next to the main prediction. It must differ from the prediction engine. Only the prediction engine and the comparison engine run; any other engine is switched off.
settings.shadow_engine.label: Comparison engine
settings.sleep_cool.description: Target temperature during sleep hours when you are home. Independent from your away setback — use this to stay cooler at night than when you leave the house.
settings.sleep_cool.label: Sleep Cooling Temperature
settings.sleep_heat.description: Target temperature during sleep hours when you are home. Independent from your away setback — use this to stay warmer at night than when you leave the house.
settings.sleep_heat.label: Sleep Heating Temperature
settings.sleep_indoor_humidity_entity.de: The humidity sensor in the bedroom, shown on the Status chart while your sleep schedule is active. Chart only: no heating or cooling decision uses it. Leave blank to detect automatically.
settings.sleep_indoor_temp_entity.descri: Optional bedroom sensor used for comfort and automation decisions while your sleep schedule is active (the thermal model always uses the primary sensor). Falls back to the primary sensor if unavailable. Leave blank to disable.
settings.sleep_indoor_temp_entity.label: Sleep Indoor Temp Sensor
settings.sleep_time.description: When bedtime temperatures take effect. The system transitions to your sleep temperatures at this time.
settings.sleep_time.label: Bedtime
settings.temp_unit.description: Whether setpoints and displayed temperatures use Fahrenheit or Celsius. Setpoints are stored internally in Fahrenheit; changing this unit affects how they are displayed and entered in the UI.
settings.temp_unit.label: Temperature Unit
settings.thermostat_companion_sensor.des: Many thermostats report the room temperature in whole degrees on the main entity while the same device also has a finer temperature sensor. 'Auto' (default) uses that finer sensor for comfort decisions once it has proven to be the same reading at finer resolution (within 1 degree F of the thermostat's reading and showing fractions while the thermostat shows whole degrees), and falls back to the thermostat's own reading whenever it is missing, unavailable, stale or disagrees. Only applies when the indoor source is the thermostat's built-in sensor. 'Off' always uses the thermostat's own reading.
Some thermostats report a reading several degrees too high for up to about 40 minutes after the furnace shuts itself off (its high-limit safety trips) while the room is still below the setpoint. When on (default), Climate Advisor spots the jump, logs a warning, shows a Repairs notice you can ignore, keeps those readings out of what it learns about the house, and reads the room from your sleep sensor or dedicated indoor sensor until the thermostat settles. Only applies when the indoor source is the thermostat's built-in sensor. Off ignores the jump.
settings.threshold_cool.description: Days whose forecast high is at or above this temperature (but below Mild) are classified as Cool; below is Cold. Default: 45°F / 7°C.
settings.threshold_cool.label: Cool day threshold
settings.threshold_hot.description: Days whose forecast high is at or above this temperature are classified as Hot. Default: 85°F / 29°C.
settings.threshold_hot.label: Hot day threshold
settings.threshold_mild.description: Days whose forecast high is at or above this temperature (but below Warm) are classified as Mild. Default: 60°F / 16°C.
settings.threshold_mild.label: Mild day threshold
settings.threshold_warm.description: Days whose forecast high is at or above this temperature (but below Hot) are classified as Warm. Default: 75°F / 24°C.
settings.threshold_warm.label: Warm day threshold
settings.tou.name: Name
settings.tou.none: No time-of-use schedules are set up.
settings.vacation_cool.description: Temperature when cooling and on vacation (Issue #1347). When not set, vacation uses the away cool temperature plus 3°F.
settings.vacation_cool.label: Vacation Cooling Temperature
settings.vacation_heat.description: Temperature when heating and on vacation (Issue #1347). When not set, vacation uses the away heat temperature minus 3°F.
settings.vacation_heat.label: Vacation Heating Temperature
settings.vacation_toggle_entity.descript: An entity that indicates vacation mode. When active, Climate Advisor applies a deeper temperature setback for extended energy savings.
settings.vacation_toggle_entity.label: Vacation Mode Toggle
settings.vacation_toggle_invert.descript: Enable if your toggle reports ON when you're NOT on vacation.
settings.vacation_toggle_invert.label: Invert Vacation Toggle
settings.wake_time.description: When morning comfort temperatures are restored. Earlier times mean the house is comfortable when you get up but use more energy overnight.
settings.wake_time.label: Wake-up Time
settings.weather_bias_enabled.descriptio: Apply a location-specific correction to tomorrow's forecast based on observed forecast accuracy.
settings.weather_bias_enabled.label: Weather Forecast Bias Correction
settings.weather_entity.description: The weather integration used for forecast data. Determines day type classification and all downstream automation decisions.
settings.weather_entity.label: Weather Service
settings.welcome_home_debounce_seconds.d: Minimum time between welcome home notifications. If someone leaves and returns within this window, the notification is suppressed. Set to 0 to always notify.
